svg.title: Logging a profile into Claude Code
svg.desc: The login hint for macOS/Linux and Windows with the command line highlighted. Illustration generated from the project's real messages, not a screenshot.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
text.tspan: To log profile "work" into Claude Code, run this in ANOTHER terminal (it opens your browser):

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
text.tspan: Or run it from a terminal with the launcher: gentle-accounts login work

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
text.tspan: When it finishes, run /gentle:accounts current to see the account.
